title: Reuters: Yen stumbles to 40-year low as clock ticks on intervention
summary: Reuters: Yen stumbles to 40-year low as clock ticks on intervention
body_markdown:
'Katayama's comments "avoided the verbal escalation that often precedes a buying effort, instead reiterating that authorities stand ready to respond at any time," ​said[Karl Schamotta](https://app.hubspot.com/social/43897234/manage/published?post=linkedincompanypage%3A76182920%3A7477766679461142528#) , chief market strategist at[Corpay Cross-Border Solutions](https://www.linkedin.com/company/76182920) . That said, "we would note that Thursday's non-farm payrolls report and Friday's Independence Day holiday — when US liquidity will thin dramatically — ​could provide attractive opportunities for wrong-footing speculative short positions," Schamotta said.'
